_comment: Pinned server software. The GitOps agent upgrades (never downgrades) to these versions after verifying the SHA-256. Only official stalwartlabs GitHub release URLs are accepted. Hashes were cross-checked against the GitHub release pages (server: sha256 shown per asset; CLI: hashes embedded in the release's stalwart-cli-installer.sh).
